map.停车视距、超车视距、决策视距计算与规范校核: Stopping sight distance, passing sight distance and decision sight distance with code checks
map.📖 查看「视距计算 使用指南」: 📖 Read the "Sight Distance Calculator User Guide"
map.SSD：停车视距(m)；V：设计速度(km/h)；t：反应时间(s)；: SSD: stopping sight distance (m); V: design speed (km/h); t: perception-reaction time (s);
map.f：纵向摩擦系数；G：纵坡(%)，上坡取正、下坡取负: f: longitudinal friction coefficient; G: longitudinal grade (%), positive uphill and negative downhill
map.💡 高速公路、一级公路应满足停车视距；二三四级公路双车道需满足超车视距；复杂路段: Tip: expressways and class-1 highways should meet stopping sight distance; two-lane class-2 to class-4 highways need passing sight distance; complex sections should meet decision sight distance.
map.停车视距 SSD = 反应距离 + 制动距离 = 0.278·V·t + V²/: Stopping sight distance SSD = reaction distance + braking distance = 0.278·V·t + V²/[254(f±G)], which guarantees a safe stop before an obstacle ahead and must be >= the code minimum (75 m at 60 km/h).
map.超车视距 PSD = d₁+d₂+d₃+d₄（初始加速、占用对向、安全间距、对向: Passing sight distance PSD = d1+d2+d3+d4 (initial acceleration, occupying the oncoming lane, safety gap, distance to the oncoming vehicle); two-lane highways must meet the code value (about 350 m at 60 km/h) for safe passing.
map.决策视距 DSD = V·t/3.6 + V²/(2·a·3.6²)，用于交叉口: Decision sight distance DSD = V·t/3.6 + V²/(2·a·3.6²), used at intersections and ramps where the driver must judge the path; the code value is higher than stopping sight distance.
map.可复现算例（停车视距 V=60, t=2.5s, f=0.35, G=0）: Reproducible example (stopping sight distance V=60, t=2.5 s, f=0.35, G=0)
map.反应距离 d₁ = 0.278×60×2.5 = 41.7 m。\n制动距离 d:
Reaction distance d1 = 0.278x60x2.5 = 41.7 m.
Braking distance d2 = 60²/[254x(0.35+0)] = 3600/88.9 = 40.5 m.
Stopping sight distance SSD = (41.7+40.5)x1.0 (safety factor k=1) = 82.2 m.
Code minimum (60 km/h) = 75 m, 82.2 >= 75 → satisfied.
On a downhill G=-0.03: d2 = 3600/[254x0.32] = 44.3 m, SSD ≈ 86.0 m, so downhill braking distance is longer.
map.反应时间 t 一般取多少？: What value is usually taken for perception-reaction time t?
map.停车视距常取 t=2.5s（含识别+反应），老人或复杂环境可取 3s；决策视距因: Stopping sight distance typically takes t=2.5 s (covering perception plus reaction); 3 s may be used for elderly drivers or complex environments; decision sight distance needs to recognize the intersection and judge the path, so t ranges from 3 to 6 s. The larger t is, the longer the sight distance required, so conservative design takes the larger value.
map.为什么下坡视距更短？: Why is sight distance shorter downhill?
map.制动距离公式分母含 (f+G)，下坡 G 为负使分母变小、制动距离变长；故下坡路: The denominator of the braking distance formula contains (f+G), and on a downhill G is negative, which shrinks the denominator and lengthens the braking distance; downhill sections therefore need longer sight distance or stronger braking assurance, so the design check should use the most adverse grade.
